messages.content: Please check whether my investment account for user_01 is active and get the USD-to-EUR exchange rate. Then prepare a high-priority email summary of my portfolio balance and trade intent in EUR. After that, look up AAPL’s current price and use that quote to buy $170.25 worth of AAPL. Once the trade is done, find alice’s contact details, prepare a message to her saying, “Trade executed successfully. Please review the audit record.”, and then create and send a high-priority email audit notification to alice.
